Source article title: Murphy McCalley
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Murphy McCalley is a member of the AC Transit District Board of Directors in California, representing Ward 4. McCalley assumed office in 2022. McCalley's current term ends on January 4, 2027.
McCalley is running for re-election to the AC Transit District Board of Directors to represent Ward 5 in California. McCalley is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
